retrievalProfile.description: A dense yellow botanical line-art background featuring a central butterfly with faces integrated into its wings and tall, stylized Art Nouveau typography.
excludeWhen: dark or gothic themes are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex, monochromatic yellow botanical illustration serves as a backdrop for a high-contrast, multi-colored butterfly. The butterfly's wings contain stylized human faces. The composition is anchored by tall, condensed, hand-drawn lettering in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic yellow background vs. high-contrast butterfly focal point
Organic botanical line work vs. structured Art Nouveau typography
Surreal integration of human portraits within insect anatomy
Dense floral texture vs. open negative space in the top right
coreInvariants: Yellow monochromatic botanical line art background
Butterfly with human faces integrated into wing patterns

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-sized butterfly is positioned slightly left of the center; typography is stacked in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, saturated butterfly with faces acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the butterfly, moves upward to the bold typography, and then wanders through the dense botanical background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is a dense 'horror vacui' of line art, though the top right has slightly more breathing room around the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard yellow (background line art and wash)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy and black (butterfly and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background contrasted with low-value, high-saturation focal points.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with organic, swelling curves
Interlocking or tightly nested character placement
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' and 'C' have deep, circular counters
The 'M' and 'N' feature elongated vertical strokes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family custom lettering with varying scales for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the Art Nouveau period style and organic curves.
Captures the tall, condensed, and stylized uppercase look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dense, monochromatic yellow botanical line drawing of flowers and branches. In the center-left, place a butterfly with dark wings that contain stylized, high-contrast human faces as part of the wing pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add tall, condensed Art Nouveau hand-lettering in the upper right corner using a dark navy color, ensuring the text is stacked and tightly spaced.

verificationChecks: Is the background monochromatic yellow line art?
Are there faces visible inside the butterfly wings?
Is the typography tall, condensed, and Art Nouveau in style?
Is the text color dark and high-contrast against the yellow?

adjustableVariables: Number of faces in the butterfly
mustRedesign: Avoid using modern digital fonts; maintain hand-drawn feel
Ensure faces are integrated into the wing anatomy, not just floating on top
postGenerationChecks: Check for organic flow between botanical elements
Verify the 'faces in wings' surrealist effect is clear
Ensure typography feels integrated into the era's style
Confirm the yellow monochrome background doesn't overpower the focal points
recipe.reuseFormula: Yellow Botanical Line Art + Surreal Butterfly Face Collage + Art Nouveau Typography
